svg.title: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: PhCHO + H2O / acid → PhCH(OH)2. Carbonyl protonation, water addition and deprotonation establish the gem-diol equilibrium. These are grouped, not a new measured elementary event.
